shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs for Smooth Arena of Valor Gameplay ⚔️📱
shortIntro.para1: Arena of Valor (AOV) is a fast-paced MOBA packed with vibrant visuals, real-time team fights, and skill-heavy gameplay. To perform at your best, your device must handle constant rendering, fast animations, and real-time input without lag spikes.
shortIntro.para2: From instant skill combos to perfectly timed ultimates, smooth gameplay depends heavily on your device’s GPU power, RAM capacity, and thermal performance. A well-optimized device ensures stable FPS, faster loading, and zero interruptions during intense 5v5 battles.

intro: Here’s the latest 2026 update of minimum and recommended requirements to run Arena of Valor smoothly on Android and iOS devices. Based on real gameplay testing across low-end, mid-range, and flagship devices 🔥.

minimum.Internet: Stable 4G or Wi-Fi connection for PvP matches

recommended.Internet: Fast Wi-Fi or 5G for lowest ping and stable matches

ios_intro: Arena of Valor runs exceptionally smooth on iOS devices 🍏 thanks to Apple's optimized hardware-software integration. Expect stable FPS, responsive controls, and minimal frame drops even during intense fights.

ios_recommended.title: Storage

faqIntroText: Common Arena of Valor questions answered for better performance and smoother gameplay 😎:

faqList.question: Is Arena of Valor heavy on phones?
faqList.answer: It’s moderately heavy. During 5v5 fights with multiple effects, low-end phones may struggle. A 4GB RAM device is recommended for smoother gameplay.

faqList.question: Can my phone run AOV at 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes, most mid-range and flagship devices can run the game at 60 FPS with optimized settings. High-end phones can even push beyond that.

faqList.question: Why does my phone heat up during AOV?
faqList.answer: High graphics settings, long matches, and background apps increase CPU and GPU load. Lower settings and proper cooling can reduce heating.
